title: News sources
author: WildWalk666
selftext:
Hi experts, may I know where you guys usually get the latest news the fastest? Any reliable news sources or platform to recommend?  
Thanks

comments.author: Big-Kangaroo-7145
comments.body: SignalPlus has a Trading Compass feature and an Economic Calendar. However, it's primarily a crypto options trading platform, so if you're only looking for news and market updates, some of its features might be more than you need.

replies.author: Big-Kangaroo-7145
replies.body: That said, it really depends on what you're trading. If you're focused on macro-driven assets, Trading Economics is probably one of the most comprehensive resources out there, although you'll need a paid plan to unlock much of its value.

comments.author: 3BBBUrf
comments.body: Nieuwsbronnen komen altijd als institutionele beleggers hun liquiditeit hebben opgeslurpt. Of anders gezegd, manipulatie voor de retailers. Mijn advies, negeer News altijd en volg de markt.

comments.author: 3BBBUrf
comments.body: Interessant waar je mee bezig bent. Wil je graag volgen. Ik draai een algoritme op TC2000. Ook in testfase, diverse entry geprobeerd. Resultaat soms 2% winst elke dag nu draait de hot BreakEven. Je strategie is mooi, klassiek maar betrouwbaar. Negeer News, laat je intuïtie het werk doen. Mijn ervaring met abonnees is instap en uitstap moment komt meestal door emoties. Waar draai jij op? TradingVieuw. Die buttons om de regie over te nemen is slim van je. Gisteren heb ik die ook toegevoegd in mijn Dash om uitschieters of entry flips te elimineren.

comments.author: WildWalk666
comments.body:
Here’s a more polished version of your message:

Hi,

I’m currently developing a trading bot that monitors the latest news sources and uses AI to analyze the information, generating either a **Buy** or **Ignore** signal.

I understand that when significant positive news is released, stock prices can react within minutes, sometimes even seconds. My goal is to operate a bot 24/7 that can detect these opportunities at the earliest possible stage and minimize the information gap between news publication and market reaction.

Therefore, I’m looking for the fastest and most reliable real-time news sources available. If your platform can provide ultra-low-latency news feeds that help me gain an edge in speed and information delivery, I would be very interested in subscribing for my project.

comments.author: Classic-Dependent517
comments.body: Trading on news never works. Period.

replies.author: WildWalk666
replies.body:
Hi,

I’ve recently noticed the same thing — sometimes the market doesn’t seem to react much to news, even though news does still matter overall.

I’m wondering whether there are any additional parameters we can include when using a trading bot to improve its training and performance. For example, beyond just the news sentiment itself, are there other signals or data points that could make the system more accurate?

I’ve also heard that some people use trading bots in their strategies. How do they typically work, and what is the general concept behind them?

I’m genuinely interested in understanding this better. Thanks.

comments.author: marius_o_h
comments.body: I used [marketaux.com](http://marketaux.com) . But I could not find any provider which have enough news older than 2022-2023 so that I could train properly my AI models.

comments.author: The_AI_Trader
comments.body: Use perplexity pro, and have it scan as you need. Set it on a schedule, or use it in real time. It's a very good news synthesizer.
